subject: RAMP activation: post-deploy verification sweep & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Park <sandra.park@acme-cloud.com>, networks@acme.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RAMP activation: post-deploy verification sweep & acceptance checklist

Hi Sandra / Acme network team,

Great to be moving this to activation week. Per our run-of-show, we intend to start the VPC on-prem ramp (tiered traffic) on Monday 2026-11-23 02:00 UTC. Before we flip live, I want to lock the post-deploy verification sweep so the ops/playbook teams have clear gates.

I've attached the activation-checklist.xlsx with the verification steps we agreed on (high-level gates + ownership). Key asks from your side:
- Confirm final ACL entries in vpc-acl-matrix.csv are applied to the border routers and transit VPC by 2026-11-22 18:00 UTC.
- Provide a point-of-contact for phys device fallbacks (Edge Hardware Ops).
- OK to proceed with staged traffic ramp (5% -> 25% -> 100%) if the smoke sweep is green at each stage.

Internal ops: Hannah & Connor, please review the checklist and confirm the canary query set and KV-cache priming window. I updated the runbook with a short canary rollback criteria section (minor edits).

Attachments: activation-checklist.xlsx (owner map + gates)

Next steps: please reply with any redlines to the checklist by EOD 11/20. If all good, I'll lock the schedule and call the preflight on Monday morning.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Program Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Sandra Park <sandra.park@acme-cloud.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: networks@acme.com, ops@edgehw.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RAMP activation: post-deploy verification sweep & acceptance checklist

Hi Tessa — thanks for the plan and the checklist. We're aligned on the timeline. A few notes from networking:

- We will apply the ACLs to the border routers and transit VPC by 11/22 15:00 UTC. The vpc-acl-matrix.csv attached reflects the final rule set (minor NAT passthrough change on rule 14).
- Edge Hardware Ops (cc'd) will be on standby for hardware fallback; they'll bring the spare uplink on call at the start of the 25% ramp.
- We validated BGP communities and the transit route filters in staging; production mirrors applied as of 11/20 10:50 UTC.

We attached the vpc-acl-matrix.csv for your ops checklist. We'll watch the canary traffic and provide a 15-minute green/nogo update at each ramp step.

Sandra Park
Principal Network Engineer, Acme Cloud
Attachments: vpc-acl-matrix.csv

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RAMP activation: post-deploy verification sweep & acceptance checklist

Tessa — looked through the activation checklist and made a few operational edits in runbook_v2.md (attached):
- Added explicit KV-cache priming step prior to 5% ramp (30m before ramp) with sample keys.
- Clarified log collection window for first-5% ramp (collect t+0 to t+10m, sample async traces).
- Canary regression criteria: 5% error rate bump sustained for >3m OR latency p50 increase >1200ms triggers rollback.

I'll run a quick playthrough of the runbook tomorrow morning with the ops bridge to ensure roles are clear. Connor, please prep the preflight packet (network pings, TLS cert fingerprint check, disk & GPU health).

Hannah
Head of Operations, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_v2.md

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Preflight: quick results & obs (pre-deploy pass)

Quick preflight summary from my run this morning (attached log: preflight-results.log):
- Network connectivity: all egress paths to Acme POPs show sub-30ms median latency; no asymmetric routing detected.
- TLS: cert fingerprints match pinned values; rotation scheduled post-activation as discussed.
- GPU/node health: 98% nodes at READY; two nodes under increased load (OOM throttle observed in staging but not repro in prod snapshot).
- KV priming: dry-run primed ~42% of target keys (priming script capped due to rate limit); we'll run full priming at T-30m.

Notes / open items:
- Recommend a short 10m quiet window between 5% -> 25% ramp to observe tail latency.
- Edge Hardware Ops: please confirm spare uplink test at T-10m.

Connor
SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
Attachments: preflight-results.log

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Park <sandra.park@acme-cloud.com>, networks@acme.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RAMP activation: post-deploy verification sweep & acceptance checklist

Thanks everyone — this is exactly the level of detail I was hoping for. TL;DR: all preflight gates are green with a couple of operational notes captured.

Plan we will run unless objections:
- Lock ACLs by 11/22 15:00 UTC (Acme confirmed).
- Final priming run at 2026-11-23 01:30 UTC (T-30m).
- Start staged traffic at 2026-11-23 02:00 UTC: 5% -> 25% (10m quiet window) -> 100% if green.
- Runbook v2 will be the canonical source during the bridge; Hannah will call the gates.

Please reply with any last-minute concerns; if none, I'll send the bridge invite and OOB escalation list tomorrow morning.

Signoff: Tessa Morgan
Program Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
